result:
I would increase humanity’s capacity for mutual understanding — not just empathy, but the ability to genuinely see people outside your own group, culture, experience, or ideology.

Many of the world’s worst harms come from fear, misunderstanding, and the failure to recognize the full reality of other people. If that could change — without removing individuality or disagreement — it might reduce cruelty, improve cooperation, and make almost every other problem easier to face.
